stations.title: Rhiannon
stations.say: Who has waited longest for a plot?
stations.note: Names are on scraps of paper.

stations.title: The waiting list
stations.text: Names on whatever paper was to hand.

captions: At Marrowfield a plot comes free, and Rhiannon must find who has waited longest.
The names are on scraps of paper from the gate, in no order she can trust.
You write the scripts that keep the list and the reports, in four tasks.
Now the list lives in a file, and the plot goes to the name at the top.
Same free plot, no scraps. Rhiannon knows who to ring.
